name: noru-grc-engineering
description: Last-mile GRC engineering plugins for Claude Code and Codex: AI inventory, privacy data maps, infrastructure checks and change control, recorded in Noru.

plugins.name: ai-inventory
plugins.description: Scan a repository for the AI systems, model providers and oversight points it actually contains, review the manifest in a PR, and land it in Noru as assets, vendors and evidence.

plugins.name: audit-pack
plugins.description: Assemble the evidence bundle, sampling and workpapers an auditor asks for — for one framework over one audit window — from Noru's graph plus the local files an integration cannot reach, and land the tested conclusion for each control back in Noru.

plugins.name: change-control
plugins.description: Who wrote each change, who approved it, who merged it and who deployed it, for one window — with every separation that did not hold owned by a named person, and the forge configuration that was supposed to keep them apart.

plugins.name: compliance-assistant
plugins.description: Claude Code and Codex plugin that guides SOC 2, ISO 27001 and other framework work through Noru's MCP server. For Noru customers.

plugins.name: dev-agents
plugins.description: Inventory the coding agents, MCP servers and plugins a repository's development process depends on, decide with the user which organization stands behind each one, and land them in Noru as vendors plus one evidence record for the window — never anything per person.

plugins.name: evidence-push
plugins.description: Work Noru's own evidence queue: see which catalogue expectations are unmet, stage local artifacts against them, and upload with control mappings.

plugins.name: findings-ingest
plugins.description: Ingest the SARIF and OSV-Scanner results that never reach a forge alert store, decide with the user what each one means here, and land them in Noru as security findings filed against risks the organization already carries — closing the ones no longer reported.

plugins.name: governance-records
plugins.description: File the records of human decisions in Noru: minutes, ISMS scope, statement of applicability, internal audit plans and reports, findings and corrective action plans, each attributed and dated.

plugins.name: iac-scan
plugins.description: Scan the Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes and CI configuration a repository actually contains, decide what each finding means in this environment, and land the result in Noru as security findings — closing the ones that no longer reproduce.

plugins.name: noru
plugins.description: Run consolidated branch reviews across independently installed GRC pieces, summarize live Noru work requiring attention with read scopes only, and check shared connection and repository context.

plugins.name: privacy-datamap
plugins.description: Read the schemas a repository actually contains — ORM models, migrations, SQL DDL, API contracts — classify the personal data in them against the Fideslang taxonomy, review the result in a pull request, and land the data map in Noru.

plugins.name: repo-enforcement
plugins.description: Install, plan, apply, and verify enforceable GitHub merge gates for the GRC Engineering workflow without granting the Noru hub administration rights.

plugins.name: review-signoff
plugins.description: Turn a periodic review of machine output — access, rules, baselines, assets, physical access, vendors — into a named, dated, expiring sign-off in Noru.

plugins.name: threat-model
plugins.description: Read the threat models a repository keeps in the Open Threat Model format, decide with the user what each threat means here, and land them in Noru's risk register linked to the organization's own controls — flagging the components other pieces found that the model leaves out.
